top10.introHtml: The best convertibles under $15K within 35 miles of Media, PA — ranked by value, condition, and deal rating. Prioritizes low mileage and strong deal badges.

picks.notes: Only 38K miles — exceptional for a 335i; twin-turbo inline-6 with serious punch.
Under 50K miles on a 2008 135i — rare at this price. High-revving N54 turbo engine.
Only 72K miles, $7,495. VW Eos has a glass-roof hardtop that closes solid as a coupe.
Low-mileage BMW 330Ci — 64K miles on a naturally aspirated inline-6 that ages beautifully.
CarGurus Great Price badge on a 328i Convertible. Best bang-for-buck in the entire result set.
Great Price on a 68K-mile G37 Convertible — VQ37 V6 is one of the best-sounding engines of its era.
2014 E350 Cabriolet with only 79K miles — genuine luxury at a fraction of original MSRP.
80K-mile Audi A5 Cabriolet with Quattro AWD — stylish, capable, and priced well below market.
Newest car in the results (2017). CarGurus Great Price. xDrive AWD for year-round driving.
2015 Audi A5 with 108K miles — still plenty of life left in a premium AWD convertible at $10,990.

manual10.introHtml: Manual-transmission convertibles from this refresh. Only one confirmed stick-shift was found — manual gearboxes are increasingly rare in used convertibles at this price point.

picks.notes: 5-speed manual GT — the only confirmed stick-shift convertible in this refresh. V8 soundtrack included.

mustangs.introHtml: Ford Mustang convertibles (2005+, S197 generation and newer) found within 35 miles of Media, PA. Ordered by price. The 2010 GT is the only manual-transmission Mustang in the results.

picks.notes: Lowest-priced Mustang in the results. High mileage but under $7,500.
V6 Convertible with 128K miles at $9,988 — solid value.
109K miles, $10,495 — Premium trim, lowest mileage of the mid-price Mustangs.
5-Speed Manual GT — the enthusiast pick. Only stick-shift convertible in the results.
